name: mergewarden
description: Review Git changes with frozen source, evidence and durable review tasks.

interface.longDescription: Run a local, asynchronous review of a configured Git checkout. Inspect saved findings and evidence through MCP. Requires Node.js 22.19+, Git, dependency setup and a separately configured Pi model login.
defaultPrompt: Use MergeWarden to review my staged changes.
Use MergeWarden to review a pull request and inspect its evidence.
